hook.description: Opens mid-confrontation with a threatening priest line and a sharp accusation about an unlicensed marriage within the first seconds, which creates immediate tension, though the opening frame has a minor hook-level setup gap about who Catherine is to the audience.

cliffhanger.description: The clip ends on a wager of ten days with the council ruling pending, which leaves the outcome open, but Alexander's closing line is a defiant acceptance that gives a sense of closure to this exchange rather than a sharp unresolved hook.

promos.why_it_works: A tense, escalating confrontation between a hostile High Priest and a defiant Alexander builds clear conflict and ends on a ten-day wager that keeps the outcome open.
warnings: Heavy reliance on unexplained backstory makes the stakes hard to follow for a new viewer
Ending is a negotiated wager rather than a sharp cliffhanger, so it is resolved in tone
Catherine has minimal dialogue and her motives remain opaque
Multiple camera-setup descriptions dilute focus on the core conflict
Relationship between Catherine and Alexander is not established
Nature of the document and the three-year 'steal' is unexplained
Why the marriage is considered invalid is only implied
Identity of the congregation and the Crown's peerage court stakes are not explained
Script timestamps; verify against video before editing.
